findings: Public entrypoint exposes package-version duplicate analysis,lock text rewriting and version update safety; not file/image content comparison.

Range helper explicitly preserves unknown as undefined for unsupported protocols/invalid semver. Required or unknown-compatible optional peer stays reachable; only known-incompatible optional peer excluded. This conservative unknown handling is a useful contract principle, not transferable semver logic for image equality.
Bare-name override authoritative even when uninterpretable; no fallback to declaration. Bun-version behavior stated in comments not independently verified or executed.

Original resolver whole-read and executed in Node with built-in TS stripping:4 authored cases pass for scoped-root discrimination, exact nested priority, closest ancestor and ambiguous/unique fallback. No Bun install/lockfile rewrite/registry run; does not qualify whole tool.

Renderer whole-read preserves object insertion/lock-key order and inline package tuples, filters undefined properties and emits trailing commas. Text reconstruction, not filesystem write; no atomic-write guarantee inferred.

Reader whole-read resolves explicit directory to bun.lock or searches cwd parents, reads full UTF8 synchronously and exits process1 on resolution/read failure. No size bound/stable snapshot/cancellation in this module; actual CLI mutation path not yet read.

CLI whole-read:plain fix,update-fix and repair-fix directly writeFileSync original path after computing result. No temp+rename, source generation check, backup or final re-read in this file; actual partial-write/concurrent mutation failure not injected. No user lockfile modified.

CLI rejects offline+fix because integrity metadata missing, distinguishes analysis/fix and aborts RegistryError instead of reporting transient missing data as partial success. Useful conservative reporting pattern; full registry/cache error behavior not executed.

Parser whole-read: JSON5 plus explicit overrides object/string validation; generic isObject includes arrays, so top-level array passes initial object check and returned cast without full schema validation. Downstream rejection/impact not established; no JSON5 execution.

Package tuple admission checks array and first element string only; metadata classified by objectness incl array. normalizeDependencyMap silently keeps string-valued entries, discarding others. This is permissive boundary, not whole-lock semantic validity proof.
Resolved spec splits last@ for scoped names; optional peer treated optional only when not also declared dependency/optional dependency. No production transfer or file/image identity algorithm.

Rewrite module wholly read: repeatedly analyzes/version-rewrites/prunes reachability up to50 passes; no explicit convergence-exhaustion status at pass cap. changed only reports any touch, not proven fixed-point completion. No cap-exhaustion fixture run.

Template clone preserves tuple source/integrity and shallow metadata, strips context-specific bundled marker when reused elsewhere; redundant nested pruning requires identical serialized tuple plus same dependency resolutions and no child subtree. These are dependency-context conditions, not file content equality.

Standalone unreachable pruning runs even without duplicate rewrite and roots only workspace declarations/workspace package names. Missing/malformed workspace input may prune entries; parser admission and CLI behavior require actual full-path fixture before calling unintended deletion.

rewriteResult.touchedEntries includes redundant nested pruning and is added to rewrittenEntries, while prunedEntries records separate unreachable pass. Counter labels need qualification; no full-tool run.

Analyzer now wholly read849 lines. Candidate target is highest existing version; additional lower targets retained when needed by lower requests. Every inbound request must be known compatible for can-dedupe; false blocks and unknown preserves version. Orphan propagation only revisits cannot-dedupe/unknown rows with nonempty requests, marks orphan when every requester is removed by planned rewrite or already orphan; monotone status changes terminate this loop. Rewrite map is fixed before orphan propagation. Static source evidence only; no semver/analyzer runtime executed.

Formatter wholly read571 lines. Default report filters unfixable/unknown-only groups and rows; empty default explicitly says no FIXABLE duplicates, while includeUnfixable says no duplicates only if rendered groups empty. Unknown request compatibility is grouped under used by (not false), not evidence of checked compatibility. Reporting policy only, not actual successful rewrite.

Report derives proposed orphan display from applied suggested updates excluding skipped identities, and requires every untouched request known compatible with shared target. Manual update reasons include skip reason/constraints; path qualification separates differing changes of same package. Display transformation does not execute update or prove filesystem mutation. Formatter runtime not executed.

Update analyzer wholly read720 lines:only cannot-dedupe requesters considered,workspace requesters skipped; inbound workspace/catalog/link/file effective ranges skipped rather than retained as unknown, then requester removed only when no usable inbound range remains. Candidate search returns first newest metadata candidate that unlocks every blocked name locally, then intersects target acceptance across all original incoming requests/co-blockers and strips unusable benefits. It does not retry alternate lower requester candidates after global intersection rejects the chosen candidate; potential missed optimization, not unsafe write proven. Dependency removal permits every eligible target; no semantic file/image equality.

Requester analysis uses unbounded Promise.all across requester list; each requester searches candidate versions sequentially. No abort/concurrency cap here; registry timeout limits remain unqualified. Progress emitted after findBestCandidate resolves,callback documented nonthrowing; rejection aborts aggregate while other work need not stop. Suggested updates sorted for report; analysis does not mutate lockfile. All observations source-only.

Update application wholly read497 lines. Assessment requires existing tuple, metadata and nonempty dist.integrity, checks required runtime/optional/nonoptional-peer dependency ranges against available versions globally; unsupported ranges or absent compatible versions are held back. Integrity presence is not downloaded-content verification.

Planner freshly reparses original lock text each round, applies remaining updates, runs normal dedupe, then checks surviving exact updated tuple outgoing dependency resolution in its own context. Conflicting updates removed and batch retried; finite shrinking batch ensures outer loop terminates, not proof inner50-pass dedupe converges. No user-file write in this module.

Context check skips pruned/replaced updated tuple and does not explicitly validate all incoming parent ranges or caller-supplied suggestion fromVersion/name against original tuple. Prior mixed unsupported inbound concern is not closed by this outgoing-only check; actual counterexample not executed, so no proven unsafe mutation claim. Registry integrity/tarball and real Bun install remain unqualified.
